title: The two scope operation paths, the scope predicate fields and the home of the LOV-SCOPE list are not specified for the scope app slice
description: (a) The legacy key names no write endpoint at all and its single endpoint row is the role read API-P4-007, so the scope read and the scope change have no path: the Ownership Map carries no row for either and TSD P4 v3 appendix T-A lists only GET /admin/roles, GET /admin/access-log and the reference-load paths, so the base of section R4 is applied by rule and the suffix is stated by RWB-P4-AD003-CON as this revision's own decision. (b) The scope predicate has no operation, no field list and no owner in any source: Architecture v5 slide 14 names the authorise inputs as role, scope and DoA without a payload, TSD P4 v3 T6.2 states only that scope filters every query, and the descriptor type is RWB-PLT-E1037-CON's, so the four field names scope, teamCode, regionCode and caseOwnerRef are stated by the contract and the operation that carries them stays RWB-P4-E1037-CON's POST /authorise. (c) The operation that returns a person's team and region codes is not named: the predicate compares teamCode and regionCode of the case (DF-CAS-011, DF-CAS-012 of rwb-case) with the caller's codes, which the session answers, and RWB-P3-E1019-CON is the only named contract over team data with no specified operation. (d) The LOV-SCOPE values OWN, TEAM, REGION, ALL are listed in TSD P4 v3 T3.2 but the lov_value table is P3's under the Ownership Map, and this key's pattern set carries no DP-07 and no reference-data contract, so the list has no data home in rwb_access and is carried as the service's own list constraint. (e) role carries no version, valid-from or valid-to column in TSD P4 v3 T3.1, so a scope change cannot be versioned as the reference loads are and is a current value with a recorded decision.

title: The scope contract has no source for its two paths, its predicate shape, its refusal entry fields or its version rule
description: (a) Neither the Ownership Map nor TSD P4 v3 appendix T-A gives the scope read or the scope change a path, so the document fixes both paths and both rights as this revision's decision on the base /api/recovery/access/v1. (b) The scope predicate has no source definition: slide 14 names role, scope and DoA as the inputs of the authorise operation with no field list, and the scope descriptor of RWB-PLT-E1037-CON fixes a type with user, team and region codes but no wire shape, so the four names scope, teamCode, regionCode and caseOwnerRef and their meanings are the document's own statement. (c) The predicate has no operation row of its own, so the contract declares it as an element of the authorise answer of RWB-P4-E1037-CON and restates no operation of that contract. (d) No source fixes the fields of the refusal entry: the local decision record is the library of DP-03 and the central ledger is P7's decision_log_entry (DF-DEC-001 to DF-DEC-018), so the document fixes only the decision code AC-DENY and the reason code OUT_OF_SCOPE and leaves the entry fields to the library. (e) role carries no version or effective-date column, so the document declares no versioned scope and states that the history of a scope is the decision record.
